title: Better file preview and more metadata in tooltips, like in Dolphin
line: Desktop and Folder View tooltips now show a large preview of the file with its type, size, modification time and details like image dimensions, page count or duration.
explanation: Folder View tooltips used Plasma's default tooltip layout, which draws the item's decoration at 32 px, so a photo's thumbnail was smaller than the icon on the desktop, and they only listed type and size ("undefined" for folders). A new ToolTipData helper requests a separate preview of up to 256 px for the hovered item through KIO::PreviewJob (same plugins as the view), and collects type, size or item count, relative modification time and, when Baloo is available, indexed width × height, title, author, artist, album, duration and page count. A shared FolderItemToolTip per view shows this Dolphin-style: preview on the left, name and a label/value list on the right; the plain tooltip for truncated names with tooltips turned off is unchanged.

commits.message:
Folder View: Show a large preview and file details in tooltips

Tooltips only showed the item's small icon-sized thumbnail with its type
and size. Now they show a large preview like Dolphin's tooltips, followed
by the type, size or item count, modification time and indexed metadata.

BUG: 337167
